physical: Gravitational mass equals inertial mass, so a freely falling observer feels no gravity: locally, free fall is indistinguishable from the absence of gravitation.
rule_reason: The equivalence keeps; mass carrying resistance does not turn an equivalence into a cost.
closing: The rule decides keeps, but mapping both masses to Movement M erases the distinction that gives the equality content. Gravitational field g is designated an acceleration, allowing Appreciation at that level, and gravitational pull has Attraction; neither maps the observer or free fall. The sentence records only the mapped equality, not a rescue of the complete principle.
